landing.hero_tagline1: Your personal dashboard to manage your life.
landing.features_sub: Not five apps. Not ten spreadsheets. One platform that tracks, reminds, syncs and protects — so you can focus on living, not managing.
landing.vp1_title: Track every aspect of your life
landing.vp1_desc: Finance, fitness, food, mood — all quantified and connected in one dashboard. Metrics you didn't know you needed, habits you didn't know you had.
landing.vp2_title: The app remembers. You don't have to
landing.vp2_desc: Set up notifications for anything — medicine reminders, overspend alerts, journal nudges. Configure it once and give your attention back to things that actually matter.
landing.vp3_title: Browser, phone or installed. Your call
landing.vp3_desc: Works as a website and installs as a PWA. Your data lives on the server — so wherever you log in, everything is exactly as you left it.
landing.vp4_title: Sensitive data? We can't read it either
landing.vp4_desc: Journal entries and medicine logs are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it. The server stores ciphertext. Nobody — including us — can see what you wrote.
landing.vp5_desc: Finance tracker, workout logger, pantry manager, journal, household finances — all in one platform, all talking to each other. No more switching context between half-baked single-purpose tools.
landing.vp6_title: Your household, not just your phone
landing.vp6_desc: Share a household context with flatmates or family. Split finances, manage shared pantry and see household-level analytics — without the group chat spreadsheet nightmare.
landing.finance_headline: Don't know where your money goes?
landing.finance_sub: Most people are surprised when they finally check. Finance makes it obvious — every transaction logged, every category tracked, every limit respected.
landing.finance_slide1_desc: Open the app and instantly see your total income, expenses and current balance. No digging, no mental math — just the numbers that matter.
landing.finance_slide2_desc: Log income and expenses in seconds. Filter by date, category or amount. Search when you need to find something specific. Your financial history — clean and complete.
landing.finance_slide3_desc: Store receipts digitally and link them to transactions. Tax season, warranty claims, expense reports — whatever the reason, your receipts are always findable.
landing.finance_slide4_desc: Charts and breakdowns show exactly which categories eat your budget. Spot the patterns you didn't notice. Adjust before it's too late.
landing.finance_slide5_title: Set the rules. Stick to them
landing.finance_slide5_desc: Define spending limits per category. See how close you are in real time. Stop overspending before it happens — not after you check the balance.
landing.fitness_sub: You won't remember what you lifted last Tuesday. Fitness logs every set, every kilo, every session — so you always know exactly how far you've come.
landing.fitness_slide1_desc: How many workouts this week? What's your current weight? Did you take your supplements? All of it — answered the moment you open the app.
landing.fitness_slide2_desc: Track every exercise with per-set weight and reps. Build a complete workout history. See what you did last session — and beat it.
landing.fitness_slide3_desc: Log your body weight regularly. See it plotted over time. Weekly changes, monthly trends — the data shows progress your eyes might miss.
landing.fitness_slide4_desc: Charts, personal records and volume trends. Progress isn't always obvious day-to-day — but over months, the numbers don't lie.
landing.fitness_slide5_desc: Track daily supplements and medications. Mark each dose. See your adherence rate. The routine you've been meaning to build — finally built.
landing.food_sub: Expired yoghurt. Forgotten leftovers. Vegetables you had plans for. Food tracks your entire pantry with live expiry status — so nothing disappears quietly.
landing.food_slide1_desc: Your full pantry, one view. Items expiring in 3 days are flagged. Items already expired are highlighted. Consume with one tap. Never buy duplicates again.
landing.food_slide2_desc: Add everything at once instead of one by one. Bulk import keeps your inventory current without making restocking feel like a chore.
landing.food_slide3_desc: Your personal recipe library, tied to your pantry. Plan meals around ingredients you need to use up. Less waste, more intention.
landing.journal_headline: The year ends. You can't remember it
landing.journal_sub: You did things. Overcame things. Achieved things. But when someone asks — or when you ask yourself — it's all a blur. Journal is your personal record: daily entries, mood, what's been grinding you down and what's genuinely been making you proud. So when December rolls around, you actually know what happened.
landing.journal_slide1_desc: Streak, entry count, average mood, monthly consistency. At a glance — the proof that you showed up. Or the reminder that you should.
landing.journal_slide2_title: What happened today? Write it down
landing.journal_slide2_desc: Free-form entry for whatever's on your mind. Rate your mood. Add what annoyed you today and what made you genuinely proud. Two minutes now — priceless context later.
landing.journal_slide3_desc: Scroll back through your entries. Read what you wrote in March. See the version of you that was struggling, or thriving, or somewhere in between. It's all there.
landing.journal_slide4_title: Patterns you didn't know were there
landing.journal_slide4_desc: Which months were rough? What's been consistently annoying you? Where does your mood dip — and what came right after? Reports turn your entries into answers.
landing.changelog_desc: LockIner is in active alpha development. This page tracks what's been shipped — features, improvements and fixes — in rough chronological order.
landing.households_sub: Splitting bills between flatmates or managing family finances shouldn't need a group chat thread. Households puts everyone on the same page, automatically.
landing.households_slide1_desc: Switch between your personal context and shared household contexts instantly. Manage your own finances and shared ones — without mixing them up.
landing.households_slide2_desc: Share access to a household with a simple invitation link. Control who's in, manage members, and keep the shared space organised.
landing.households_slide3_title: Who spent what? Now you know.
landing.households_slide3_desc: Household-level breakdowns show shared spending, contributions per member and category totals. No guessing. No awkward conversations.
landing.skills_headline: You start. You drift. You forget.
landing.skills_sub: Learning something new is easy. Finishing it is not. Skills keeps your learning paths structured, your sessions logged and your consistency visible — so you actually make it.
landing.skills_slide1_desc: Create a learning journey for any skill. Define milestones, track progress and see how far you are from where you want to be.
landing.skills_slide2_desc: Log every study or practice session as it happens. Build a history of real effort — not intentions. Your consistency becomes the proof.
